verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an official Python SDK, installed via pip install tavily-python and maintained in the tavily-ai/tavily-python GitHub repo. It covers search, extract, crawl, map and research, and adds keyless mode, project and session attribution, and LLM-oriented helpers such as get_search_context and qna_search. An official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK also has its own quick-start and reference docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs in use, since all evidence is first-party docs and the vendor's own repo.
